description: Silvia Meniconi, Bruno Brunone and Filomena Maietta publish pressure-head time histories from the University of Perugia's Water Engineering Laboratory. The spatial coverage is an experimental pipe network containing two square loops, each 100 by 100 metres, and a short branch. A rapid, complete closure of the branch's downstream valve generates the measured transients; time zero marks the start of that manoeuvre. Zenodo lists the MATLAB file 5u_q015.mat, freely available under CC BY 4.0 since September 2021. The public metadata do not specify the observation date, sampling frequency, sensor accuracy or every pipe parameter, so those details remain unknown. These measurements can check transient hydraulic simulations and their response to valve operations. The laboratory geometry should not be mistaken for a municipal distribution network. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified, and no experimental files were downloaded.
